title: Physics Brawl Online — AI-participant non-comparable draft

applicability.notes: This is the online ruleset, not the in-person Fyziklání ruleset.

required_roles.title: captain and solver
duties: Allocate problems, monitor scoring risk, and submit the team's numerical answers.

fill_role.title: physics solver
duties: Solve assigned problems, include units and significant figures, and share checks with the team.

turn_budget.derivation: The three-hour online contest is represented by a bounded agent-turn budget.

state_requirements.description: Main and Hurry-up problem series unlock progressively through the official environment.
Incorrect attempts reduce points and impose a one-minute series lockout.
The live scoreboard hides information near the end of the contest.

internet.conditions: Internet and literature are allowed under the online rules; contacting outsiders for help remains forbidden.

constraints.statement: An online team contains one to five contestants.
Generative AI is strictly prohibited and can cause disqualification.
constraints.waiver_reason: The benchmark participants are LLM agents.

constraints.statement: Contestants may not contact teachers, other teams, or other outsiders for problem-solving help.

collaboration.notes: The roster generator supports every official size from one to five.

submission.official_deliverable: numerical answers entered in the online platform
submission.adaptation: The progressive online interface and attempt lifecycle are not reproduced.

evaluation.notes: Gold answers are available, but official attempt penalties and time-dependent scoring remain unsupported.

waivers.official_rule: Generative AI is prohibited and disqualifying.
waivers.benchmark_treatment: Generative AI agents solve the contest tasks.

sources.title: Physics Brawl Online Rules
sources.locator: Team size, permitted resources, AI prohibition, scoring, and verification

provenance.notes: The old provided_materials_only flag is removed because the online rules explicitly allow Internet and literature.
